ai.seo_question: What are the Ten Nights of Dhu al-Hijjah?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, these ten nights are deeply connected to the martyrdom of Imam al-Husayn (AS) at Karbala, transforming the period of general virtue into a time of profound mourning and reflection. This duality allows for both increased worship and commemoration of the Ahl al-Bayt, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the month of Dhu al-Hijjah beyond its ritualistic aspects.
